sentences.s: 你最喜欢什么作业系统？
sentences.t: 你最喜歡什麼作業系統？
sentences.en: What's your favorite operating system?

sentences.s: 这台电脑差不多5000块。
sentences.t: 這臺電腦差不多5000塊。
sentences.en: This computer is about 5,000 yuan.

source.title: 差不多 #
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 你喜欢什么牌子的酸奶？
sentences.t: 你喜歡什麼牌子的酸奶？
sentences.en: What's your favorite brand of yogurt?

sentences.s: 我明天还要再去看看。
sentences.t: 我明天還要再去看看。
sentences.en: I will go see it again tomorrow.

source.title: 再 V
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 我加粗了我觉得有趣的文章。
sentences.t: 我加粗了我覺得有趣的文章。
sentences.en: I've boldfaced the articles that I found interesting.

sentences.s: 不管喜不喜欢，我们都得参加那个会议。
sentences.t: 不管喜不喜歡，我們都得參加那個會議。
sentences.en: Like it or not, we have to attend that meeting.

sentences.s: 她快速地翻过这本杂志。
sentences.t: 她快速地翻過這本雜誌。
sentences.en: She paged quickly through the magazine.

sentences.s: 汤姆总是在看电视。
sentences.t: 湯姆總是在看電視。
sentences.en: Tom is always watching television.

sentences.s: 今天我一定陪你逛街逛到底，保证让你买到合适的衣服。
sentences.t: 今天我一定陪你逛街逛到底，保證讓你買到合適的衣服。
sentences.en: Today I will go shopping with you to the end. [I can] guarantee that you will buy the right clothes.

source.title: 到底
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 她翻译了一首诗。
sentences.t: 她翻譯了一首詩。
sentences.en: She translated a poem.

sentences.s: 我不相信孩子能独自到东京。
sentences.t: 我不相信孩子能獨自到東京。
sentences.en: I don't believe the child came to Tokyo alone.

sentences.s: 她承认我的声明是真实的。
sentences.t: 她承認我的聲明是真實的。
sentences.en: She acknowledged that my statement was true.

sentences.s: 吸烟会影响我们的健康。
sentences.t: 吸菸會影響我們的健康。
sentences.en: Smoking affects our health.

sentences.s: 你变胖了。
sentences.t: 你變胖了。
sentences.en: You've grown fat.

sentences.s: 人们想要和平。
sentences.t: 人們想要和平。
sentences.en: People want peace.

sentences.s: 他的演讲持续了三个小时。
sentences.t: 他的演講持續了三個小時。
sentences.en: His speech lasted three hours.

sentences.s: 我愿意参加这场会议。
sentences.t: 我願意參加這場會議。
sentences.en: I am willing to attend the meeting.

sentences.s: 他想到一个好主意。
sentences.t: 他想到一個好主意。
sentences.en: A good idea occurred to him.

sentences.s: 我每天都帮我妈做家务。
sentences.t: 我每天都幫我媽做家務。
sentences.en: I help my mother with the housework every day.

sentences.s: 当我告知她那件消息时，怀特小姐哭了出来。
sentences.t: 當我告知她那件消息時，懷特小姐哭了出來。
sentences.en: Mrs. White broke into tears when I told her the news.

sentences.s: 我活在梦里。
sentences.t: 我活在夢裏。
sentences.en: I'm living the dream.

sentences.s: 医生建议这个病人停止吸烟。
sentences.t: 醫生建議這個病人停止吸菸。
sentences.en: The doctor suggests the patient stop smoking.

sentences.s: 他知道这个秘密。
sentences.t: 他知道這個祕密。
sentences.en: He knows the secret.

sentences.s: 他出国留学了。
sentences.t: 他出國留學了。
sentences.en: He studied abroad.

sentences.s: 我爸爸不是每天都走路上班的。
sentences.t: 我爸爸不是每天都走路上班的。
sentences.en: My father does not always walk to work.

sentences.s: 这座工厂生产玩具。
sentences.t: 這座工廠生產玩具。
sentences.en: This factory produces toys.

sentences.s: 这很容易。
sentences.t: 這很容易。
sentences.en: This is easy.

sentences.s: 她送来了一份礼物以表示感谢。
sentences.t: 她送來了一份禮物以表示感謝。
sentences.en: She sent a gift to express her gratitude.

source.title: 以
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 我的头发很容易打卷。
sentences.t: 我的頭髮很容易打卷。
sentences.en: My hair curls easily.

sentences.s: 小宝宝的名字决定好了吗？
sentences.t: 小寶寶的名字決定好了嗎？
sentences.en: Have you decided on a name for your baby?

sentences.s: 黑板需要擦擦了。
sentences.t: 黑板需要擦擦了。
sentences.en: The blackboard needs erasing.

sentences.s: 刚才我收到了一封电子邮件。
sentences.t: 剛纔我收到了一封電子郵件。
sentences.en: I just received an email.

source.title: 刚才
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 出去散步怎么样？
sentences.t: 出去散步怎麼樣？
sentences.en: How about going out for a walk?

sentences.s: 那是你昨天买的毛衣吗？
sentences.t: 那是你昨天買的毛衣嗎？
sentences.en: Is that the sweater you bought yesterday?

sentences.s: 他们的讲词好好笑。
sentences.t: 他們的講詞好好笑。
sentences.en: Their speech is funny.

sentences.s: 汤姆拍了不只一张照，是吗？
sentences.t: 湯姆拍了不只一張照，是嗎？
sentences.en: Tom took more than one picture, didn't he?

sentences.s: 你能解决这个问题呢吗？
sentences.t: 你能解決這個問題呢嗎？
sentences.en: Can you solve this problem?

sentences.s: 她终于到达了酒店。
sentences.t: 她終於到達了酒店。
sentences.en: She finally reached the hotel.

sentences.s: 他的工作工资很高，工作时间也相当理想。
sentences.t: 他的工作工資很高，工作時間也相當理想。
sentences.en: His salary is high, and the hours are pretty good, too.

sentences.s: 不要浪费时间。
sentences.t: 不要浪費時間。
sentences.en: Don't waste time.

sentences.s: 这张椅子很舒服。
sentences.t: 這張椅子很舒服。
sentences.en: This chair is very comfortable.

sentences.s: 事情已经发生了，你再后悔也无法改变，别伤心了。
sentences.t: 事情已經發生了，你再後悔也無法改變，別傷心了。
sentences.en: Things have already happened, no matter how you regret it you (still) won’t be able to change it, don't be sad.

source.title: 再……也......
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 他有三个女儿，一个结了婚，其余两个还没有。
sentences.t: 他有三個女兒，一個結了婚，其餘兩個還沒有。
sentences.en: He has three daughters; one is married, but the others aren't.

sentences.s: 我带你去医院检查检查吧。
sentences.t: 我帶你去醫院檢查檢查吧。
sentences.en: Let me take you to the hospital for to check up a bit.

source.title: V + V
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 你可以帮我十分钟吗？
sentences.t: 你可以幫我十分鐘嗎？
sentences.en: Could you help me for ten minutes?

sentences.s: 汤姆有三任妻子。她们全是加拿大人。
sentences.t: 湯姆有三任妻子。她們全是加拿大人。
sentences.en: Tom has had three wives. They were all Canadians.

sentences.s: 毕业后大家都很忙，再说，很多同学不在一个城市。
sentences.t: 畢業後大家都很忙，再說，很多同學不在一個城市。
sentences.en: After graduation, everyone was very busy. Besides, many students are not in a city.

source.title: 再说
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 我之前没跟你说过吗？
sentences.t: 我之前沒跟你說過嗎？
sentences.en: Haven't I told you this before?

sentences.s: 他们在追求幸福。
sentences.t: 他們在追求幸福。
sentences.en: They are after happiness.

sentences.s: 那是我的台词！
sentences.t: 那是我的臺詞！
sentences.en: That's MY line!

sentences.s: 他一边唱歌一边跳舞。
sentences.t: 他一邊唱歌一邊跳舞。
sentences.en: He sang while he danced.

source.title: 一边 + V1 + 一边 + V2
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 我增加了体重。
sentences.t: 我增加了體重。
sentences.en: I've gained weight.

sentences.s: 上个星期我们在我阿姨的家。
sentences.t: 上個星期我們在我阿姨的家。
sentences.en: We were at my aunt's last week.

sentences.s: 你通常什么时候起床？
sentences.t: 你通常什麼時候起牀？
sentences.en: What time do you usually get up?

sentences.s: 我们从这儿走就能追上他们。
sentences.t: 我們從這兒走就能追上他們。
sentences.en: If we go this way, we'll catch up with them.

sentences.s: 他每天都在公园中跑步。
sentences.t: 他每天都在公園中跑步。
sentences.en: He runs in the park every day.

sentences.s: 它可能永远都不会发生。
sentences.t: 它可能永遠都不會發生。
sentences.en: It may never happen.

sentences.s: 我累得只想躺在床上。
sentences.t: 我累得只想躺在牀上。
sentences.en: I was too tired to care for anything but bed.

sentences.s: 网上买的那本书估计三天左右就能到。
sentences.t: 網上買的那本書估計三天左右就能到。
sentences.en: The book bought online is estimated to be available in about three days.

source.title: # 左右
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 你应该到我们的派对的。
sentences.t: 你應該到我們的派對的。
sentences.en: You ought to have come to our party.

sentences.s: 我们试过阻止他了。
sentences.t: 我們試過阻止他了。
sentences.en: We tried to stop him.

sentences.s: 你不喜欢巧克力对吧？
sentences.t: 你不喜歡巧克力對吧？
sentences.en: You don't like chocolate, do you?

sentences.s: 你真觉得我们有机会赢吗？
sentences.t: 你真覺得我們有機會贏嗎？
sentences.en: Do you really think we have a chance to win?

sentences.s: 德黑兰是伊朗的首都。
sentences.t: 德黑蘭是伊朗的首都。
sentences.en: Tehran is the capital of Iran.

sentences.s: 我觉得在寒冷的早晨很难早起。
sentences.t: 我覺得在寒冷的早晨很難早起。
sentences.en: I find it hard to get up early on cold mornings.

sentences.s: 请把这个瓶子装满水。
sentences.t: 請把這個瓶子裝滿水。
sentences.en: Please fill this bottle with water.

sentences.s: 如果每周你跑步两三次，你应该可以减肥。
sentences.t: 如果每週你跑步兩三次，你應該可以減肥。
sentences.en: If you went jogging two or three times a week, you could probably lose some weight.

sentences.s: 女儿个子跟我差不多一样高。
sentences.t: 女兒個子跟我差不多一樣高。
sentences.en: My daughter is about as tall as me.

source.title: 差不多 A
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 我兴奋得吃不下任何东西。
sentences.t: 我興奮得喫不下任何東西。
sentences.en: I'm too excited to eat anything.

sentences.s: 我想他得花两个小时才能把工作做完。
sentences.t: 我想他得花兩個小時才能把工作做完。
sentences.en: It will take him two hours to finish the work.

sentences.s: 天空中有数十亿的星星。
sentences.t: 天空中有數十億的星星。
sentences.en: There are billions of stars in the sky.

sentences.s: 这样的行为导致问题。
sentences.t: 這樣的行爲導致問題。
sentences.en: Such behavior gives rise to problems.

sentences.s: 经理您放心，我一定以最快的速度完成。
sentences.t: 經理您放心，我一定以最快的速度完成。
sentences.en: Manager, you can rest assured that I will finish at the fastest speed.

source.title: 以 N
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 很快人群就在他周围聚集了起来。
sentences.t: 很快人羣就在他周圍聚集了起來。
sentences.en: A crowd soon gathered around him.

sentences.s: 无论/不管做什么事都要注意方法，正确的方法可以让我们做得更好。
sentences.t: 無論/不管做什麼事都要注意方法，正確的方法可以讓我們做得更好。
sentences.en: Regardless of what you do, choose the right [lit. pay attention to] your methods. The right way can make us do better.

source.title: 无论/不管 Q 都
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 人要为自己的行为负责。
sentences.t: 人要爲自己的行爲負責。
sentences.en: One must be responsible for one's conduct.

sentences.s: 天冷了或者工作累了的时候，喝杯热茶很舒服。
sentences.t: 天冷了或者工作累了的時候，喝杯熱茶很舒服。
sentences.en: When the weather is cold or when you’re tired from work, it is very comfortable to drink a cup of hot tea.

source.title: N1 或者 N2
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 我不认识符合条件的人。
sentences.t: 我不認識符合條件的人。
sentences.en: I don't know anyone who meets that description.

sentences.s: 让我用一张图来说明。
sentences.t: 讓我用一張圖來說明。
sentences.en: Let me explain it with a diagram.

sentences.s: 汤姆以前每年夏天都去波士顿。
sentences.t: 湯姆以前每年夏天都去波士頓。
sentences.en: Tom used to come to Boston every summer.

sentences.s: 她的大女儿结婚了。
sentences.t: 她的大女兒結婚了。
sentences.en: Her older daughter is married.

sentences.s: 我本来想当律师，不过后来我发现自己对新闻更感兴趣。
sentences.t: 我本來想當律師，不過後來我發現自己對新聞更感興趣。
sentences.en: I originally wanted to be a lawyer, nevertheless I found myself more interested in news.

source.title: 不过
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 我们有任何我可以当零食吃的东西吗？
sentences.t: 我們有任何我可以當零食喫的東西嗎？
sentences.en: Do we have anything I can snack on?

sentences.s: 她教阅读和写作。
sentences.t: 她教閱讀和寫作。
sentences.en: She teaches reading and writing.

sentences.s: 我想你能理解的。
sentences.t: 我想你能理解的。
sentences.en: I'm sure you can understand.

sentences.s: 我想把门关上。
sentences.t: 我想把門關上。
sentences.en: I want to close the door.

sentences.s: 我要是不需要明天做就好了。
sentences.t: 我要是不需要明天做就好了。
sentences.en: I hope I don't have to do that tomorrow.

sentences.s: 咱们午饭后就去附近的公园散散步吧。
sentences.t: 咱們午飯後就去附近的公園散散步吧。
sentences.en: Let's go for a walk in the nearby park after lunch.

source.title: V + V + O
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 我还没想好去爬山还是去看电影。
sentences.t: 我還沒想好去爬山還是去看電影。
sentences.en: I haven't decided whether to go hiking or to go to the movies.

source.title: N1 还是 N2
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 我想跟你这样的人结婚。
sentences.t: 我想跟你這樣的人結婚。
sentences.en: I'd like to get married to someone like you.

sentences.s: 告诉我什么时候停下。
sentences.t: 告訴我什麼時候停下。
sentences.en: Tell me when to stop.

sentences.s: 那真是无聊。
sentences.t: 那真是無聊。
sentences.en: That was really boring.

sentences.s: 变美丽的最简单方法就是微笑。
sentences.t: 變美麗的最簡單方法就是微笑。
sentences.en: Smiling is a cheap way to be prettier.

sentences.s: 读书使/叫/让我快乐。
sentences.t: 讀書使/叫/讓我快樂。
sentences.en: Reading makes me happy.

source.title: 使/叫/让 + O + A/V
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 我不知道天色变暗了。
sentences.t: 我不知道天色變暗了。
sentences.en: It became dark before I knew it.

sentences.s: 把那两本书拿出来！
sentences.t: 把那兩本書拿出來！
sentences.en: Take out those two books!

sentences.s: 我买了一支手表给她。
sentences.t: 我買了一支手錶給她。
sentences.en: I bought her a watch.

sentences.s: 汤姆不认为有人会认出玛丽。
sentences.t: 湯姆不認爲有人會認出瑪麗。
sentences.en: Tom didn't think that anybody would recognize Mary.

sentences.s: 开始很难。
sentences.t: 開始很難。
sentences.en: Getting started was difficult.

sentences.s: 他每天去学校学习。
sentences.t: 他每天去學校學習。
sentences.en: He goes to school to study every day.

sentences.s: 可以相信他到什么程度？
sentences.t: 可以相信他到什麼程度？
sentences.en: To what extent can he be trusted?

sentences.s: A：没想到咱们毕业都已经十年了。B：可不是！时间过得太快了，真想大家。
sentences.t: A：沒想到咱們畢業都已經十年了。B：可不是！時間過得太快了，真想大家。
sentences.en:
A: I didn't expect that we have graduated for ten years.
B: Tell me about it! Time flies too fast, I really miss everyone.

source.title: 可不是！
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 烦不烦人呀！
sentences.t: 煩不煩人呀！
sentences.en: Isn't that annoying?

sentences.s: 我每天去咖啡店喝咖啡。
sentences.t: 我每天去咖啡店喝咖啡。
sentences.en: Every day I go to the café and have coffee.

sentences.s: 这个城市的地铁已经有上百年的历史了。
sentences.t: 這個城市的地鐵已經有上百年的歷史了。
sentences.en: The city's subway has been around for over a hundred years.

source.title: 上 #
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 她买了一个玩具给她的孩子。
sentences.t: 她買了一個玩具給她的孩子。
sentences.en: She bought a toy for her child.

sentences.s: 说起吃的东西，给我印象最深的是湖南菜。
sentences.t: 說起喫的東西，給我印象最深的是湖南菜。
sentences.en: Speaking of food, the one that impressed me the most is Hunan cuisine.

source.title: 说起 O
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 问题还没有被解决呢。
sentences.t: 問題還沒有被解決呢。
sentences.en: The problem has not been solved yet.

source.title: O + 不/没 + 被/叫/让 + S + V
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 我在法国南边的一座小山买了一所房子，准备在那里建设老人院。
sentences.t: 我在法國南邊的一座小山買了一所房子，準備在那裏建設老人院。
sentences.en: I bought a house on a small hill in southern France in preparation of building a retirement home.

sentences.s: 他毕业后在老家工作了一年，接着又考上了北京大学，读研究生。
sentences.t: 他畢業後在老家工作了一年，接着又考上了北京大學，讀研究生。
sentences.en: After graduating, he worked in his hometown for a year. And then he was admitted to Peking University to study for graduate students.

source.title: 接着
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 那些葡萄看起来很甜，但其实是酸的。
